breakdown.description: FCC lattice description is combined with the BCC unit-cell population in the density relation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses n = 4 atoms per unit cell, which corresponds to the FCC unit-cell population, rather than the BCC value of 2. This resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use the BCC unit-cell population (n=2) despite describing an FCC structure.
